questions.stemHtml: An 11-month-old boy is admitted to the hospital following an episode of seizure. He has a history of delayed developmental milestones. He currently weighs 6.8 kg with a height of 67 cm. His seizures did not recur, and his vitals remain stable. There is decreased muscle bulk, hypertonia, hyperreflexia, and a positive Babinski sign. Funduscopy reveals bilateral optic atrophy and the given finding: What is the most likely diagnosis?
